items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: supposed to start at 7 o'clock this drummer Arthur Hogan he must have got them five or ten minutes after

ctx.x: Yeah, he had the dance band. I called him Kid Nicholas. We had a... He on cornet. I was on trombone. Israel Garmin used to play with Cl seventh. I thought about him there was Lucky's to live up in Cowarton. He used to play bass. Arthur Ogans.

You were talking about Wooden Joe. I'm not sure we got all of the men on. The drummer, who was the drummer with Wooden Joe? Arthur Ogans. Oh yes. And the banjo? John Smith. Yeah, I think we got the others. Did you mention any bass player?
Yeah, we used to call him Buddy Luck. I forget his right name, but we used to call him Buddy Luck.
